    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    pts={c:[(r,k) for r in range(h) for k in range(w) if grid[r][k]==c]

    src=pts[4]
    r0=min(r for r,c in src); c0=min(c for r,c in src)
    base={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in src}
    def norm(shape):
        a=min(r for r,c in shape); b=min(c for r,c in shape)
        return frozenset((r-a,c-b) for r,c in shape)
    variants=[]
    for flip in (False,True):
      for rot in range(4):
        s=set()
        for r,c in base:
          if flip: c=-c
          for _ in range(rot): r,c=c,-r

        v=norm(s)

    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells in pts.items():
      if color==4: continue

        for ar in range(-h,h*2):
